author: Komorebi P.
target: Simultaneous coefficient and parameter deformation for actual p-adic polynomial systems: exact prescribed parameters, constructed root, full solved-ball uniqueness, displacement M-s, and combined first-order formula with integral error depth 2M-3s under only the original solved inverse bound and M>2s.
first_order_motion: Preserved Lean-certified theorem from previous release.
joint_deformation: Lean-certified actual augmented system and inverse certificate, exact parameter change, unique solved-coordinate root, and first-order formula with both coefficient and parameter terms.
limitations: Earlier non-polynomial proofs are preserved with their historical verification, not recompiled in this gate.
General rationally rank-deficient singular persistence is outside the joint deformation theorem.
Earlier rectangular chart interfaces retain their integer coefficients and integer centers.
No claim of analytic regularity, native presentation invariance, or global/completed descent.
